mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth > 150,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction starts (HOUST) falling below 1,000,000 units annually signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (HOUST < 1000.0), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive monthly declines in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (two consecutive INDPRO declines), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 2.0% annualized signals accommodative policy amid inflation, compressing risk premia and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST decline and RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals shifting consumer spending patterns that boost retail sales while reducing housing demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (HOUST decline and RSAFS growth > 0.5%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor conditions that increase consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE decline in high-unemployment regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), two consecutive monthly INDPRO declines signal deepening contraction that reduces corporate output, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods within manufacturing slowdown regime, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
